The avoidance of social interactions and discomfort around people, along with poor academic performance due to anxiety, further supports this diagnosis. The emphasis on the paranormal and interpreting events as signs, while unusual, does not fully meet the criteria for schizophrenia, especially given the lack of hallucinations or delusions. Schizotypal personality disorder has been ruled out by previous experts, leaving Avoidant Personality Disorder as the most fitting diagnosis given the remaining options.
